clarification: If open and stat succeed but the descriptor is not a regular file, deliberate input admission refusal exits 2 and emits structured stderr with no stdout. An actual open/stat/read error exits 1. The reader must avoid waiting on a named pipe merely to classify it (for example, use nonblocking read-open where supported before descriptor stat). This resolves the previously unenumerated successful-stat non-regular classification without changing existing content or I/O rules.
unchanged: All other contract fields, source fence, blind-before-candidate ordering and no-Actions hold remain unchanged.
